column5: MEASURED LIVE THIS PASS AND BUILT, in skai-gaming 7d7c7885. The recorded residual was the whole of this row - wave 41 closed the wiring and left "the frame's own tile geometry, type and the Blackjack-specific tiles were NOT measured at this width" - so the board was read first-hand with get_metadata on 11092:73531 and get_design_context on the panel body 11096:108190. ★ THE READ OVERTURNS A RUNG THIS COMPONENT CARRIED IN ITS OWN COMMENT, and the comment was the only thing asserting it: it read "one tile across at 375, two at the 768 tablet cut, four at 1440". The 768 board draws FOUR. Frame 270 11096:108205 is 676 wide holding four 163x100 tiles at x=0/171/342/513, a 171 pitch on an 8 gap, and (676 - 3 x 8)/4 = 163 exactly; the second row 11096:108243 is three 220s at x=0/228/456 on the same 8. So md:grid-cols-2 was two rungs wrong and gap-3 was 12 where every seam on this board is 8. Both are now md:grid-cols-4 and gap-2, and the test DERIVES the tile width from the column and the gap rather than asserting the class, so a rung nobody measured cannot pass again. THE COLUMN ITSELF MOVED 32: the board gives the metrics block no card of its own - it sits directly on the tab body Frame 267, whose surface the Live chat tab shares - where this file drew its own rounded-2xl green-coal-300 card with p-4 inside GameInfoTabPanel's px-4, putting the tiles on 644 against the frame's 676. The card is gone. TILE BOX, and the stroke decided by arithmetic on DECLARED padding: get_design_context gives p-[var(--s-4,16px)] and Frame 274 is a real edge child at (16,16) sized 131x68, its 68 being its own content (16 label + 32 + 20 value) and not a leftover, so 16 + 68 + 16 = 100 EQUALS the frame's reported height - stroke drawn inside and uncounted - and CSS pays p-[15px] + border. Paying the full 16 beside a border would close the tile at 102. TYPE, all four values changed and all four were wrong: label Manrope Regular 12/16 at -0.48 in WHITE where this drew text-ash; value Mulish Regular 16/20 at -0.64 where this drew Manrope text-xl BOLD; the delta beside the value on a 4 gap in Mulish 14/16 at -0.56 alien-green-bright; the note beside it on an 8 gap in Mulish 12/14 at -0.48 coral - the board puts both BESIDE the value, and this file rendered both beneath it on mt-1, which cannot fit under a value pinned to the floor of a 100-tall tile. HEADING: a 3px rounded-6 bar on an 8 gap then Manrope Bold 14 leading 18.048 tracking -0.56, with the band held at the frame's 32. ⚠ the bar's green is rgba(23,249,180,0.24) = alien-green-BRIGHT at 24 percent, and it is written as a modifier on that token rather than as semanticColors.green.opacity24, which is rgba(45,237,173,0.24) off #2DEDAD - a different hue that would have looked correct in review. BET TOTAL, Frame 304: a green-coal-300 card radius 12 pad 16 gap 16, cells green-coal-200 radius 8 pad 16 with NO stroke (so they pay the full 16), grouped 2 + 2 because the board draws two gaps not one - 153/12/153/8/153/12/153 = 644 - and the secondary line is the value's colour at 64 percent on a toned cell but ash outright on an untoned one, which are two rules and not one. The rule 11096:108294 is a ZERO-height node whose 1px stroke overflows both ways, so it is built as a 0-height box with an absolutely placed hairline: a bordered box would take a row and close the card at 186 against the frame's 185 (16 + 19 + 16 + 0 + 16 + 102 + 16). ⛔ WHY THE ROW STAYS PARTIAL, and neither item is geometry - both are figures with no source, so neither was drawn. (a) The board's SECOND tile row is three Blackjack tiles - Bust rate 11096:108244, Double success 108257, Split wins 108270 - each carrying a progress bar and a "Platform average:" figure. A platform average is a cross-user aggregate and gaming_my_recent_rounds is bound to auth.uid(), returning the caller's rows only; the bar fraction has no source at all (the board's own three read 48.6, 8 and 44 of 188 against values 2.4%, 0% and 4, which is sample layout and not a mapping). Deriving the bars from the player's own figures would be a fabrication in the shape of a comparison. A cross-user rollup needs a new definer read and supabase/ is fenced. (b) The 100x32 "All time" control 11096:108202 is a time-window filter and the rollup takes no window, so a picker that filters nothing would be a dead control; the frame's 32-tall band is kept without it. Neither figure was invented and no money path moved - every value still arrives pre-formatted from the caller and nothing is zero-filled. ⚠ ONE COLOUR CARRIED, NOT MEASURED: the hairline is drawn in green-coal-100 off the panel's own stroke token; its vector fill 11096:108294 was not read. Second witness file modules/skai-gaming/src/components/play/game-detail/gameStatsPanelBoard.test.tsx, 10 tests green, which also asserts no platform-average text and no progress bar reach the tree. ⛔ NOT MINE, PRE-EXISTING RED, in a file in this lane's owns: GameInfoTabPanel.test.tsx:70 and :78 render GameInfoTabPanel with no Router and useNavigate() entered that component at :174 in f08b3ca4, so both throw; :78 uses tab="Live chat" and never mounts this panel at all, which is what identifies the break as f08b3ca4's and not this build's. Fixed separately. done here means it landed on skai-gaming main, not that a user can see it.

RE-READ LIVE THIS PASS AND THE CARRIED CONCLUSION IS OVERTURNED - not its numbers, which all check out, but its ASK. The wave 59 row ended "closing 375 needs a SECOND export of roulette-cover at the Mobile board wheel scale, i.e. new asset bytes", and it flagged its own Desktop half as "CARRIED, NOT RE-DERIVED" from 10296-3783, a node it had not opened. That node was opened this pass with get_design_context, which is what moves this row. ★ THE PAIR SHARES ONE FILL, AND FOR ROULETTE THAT WAS NEVER ON THE RECORD. 10296-3783 declares c8ddb.png - the same content hash 10296-3788 declares - so the two boards draw the SAME export, and the vverify line for the Desktop (the only other reading of it) records no hash at all, which is why the pair rule every other cover card in this slice was closed on had never been applied here. Desktop declaration, first-hand: h-[112.93%] left-[-27.57%] top-0 w-[155.15%] on a 195x277 card, ground #3051AA over #001615, vignette 179.8616deg from rgba(48,81,170,0) 34.384% to rgb(48,81,170) 74.688% over backdrop-blur-[2.729px], inset 0/1.091/27.285 rgba(255,255,255,0.14), drop 0/1/4 rgba(0,0,0,0.75), caption 10296:3785 at left-[31px] top-[213px] w-[132px] on an 8 gap, Manrope ExtraBold 24/24 -0.96 uppercase over Mulish 11/14 -0.44 at 64%. Every figure the carried note stated is confirmed to the digit, including the cross-width ratio it flagged as carried: 144.99/155.15 = 0.93451 against the 0.9345 recorded. ★★ WHAT THE PAIR ACTUALLY IS, derived here from the two declarations and not from either note: the fill is drawn at aspect 0.967158 on the Desktop and 0.967219 on the Mobile - agreeing to four decimals, which is the arithmetic proof of the shared hash - and 0.9672 is WIDER than both cuts (195:277 = 0.7039711, 76.268:108 = 0.7061852), so a cover fit matches HEIGHT and each frame's h- IS its zoom outright. Desktop 1.12930, Mobile 1.05860, and on BOTH boards the zoom read off the width equals the zoom read off the height to five decimals (gap 0.00000) - so unlike the crash pair, and unlike the plinko and mines Desktops, neither roulette board stretches its fill and both reproduce EXACTLY under a uniform scale. Anchors derived per board rather than copied: hidden-left share 0.49991 and 0.49989, i.e. centred to four decimals on both; hidden-above share 0.00000 and 0.00171, i.e. the top edge held still on both. So the pair AGREES on origin-top and differs only in magnitude, 7.07pp apart - precisely the shape wave 60 built FigmaGameArt.artZoomClass for. ⛔⛔ SO THE ASK IS NOT A SECOND EXPORT, AND THAT IS THE OVERTURN. The blocker is real but it is a different blocker: the entry is keyed roulette-pro at playGameArt.ts:928 and ships roulette-cover.webp, 1080x1534 on disk = aspect 0.704042, which is NOT c8ddb.png - it is a pre-cropped FLATTEN taken at the Desktop card's own framing, so it covers at ~100%/100.30% in either cut, has no overflow to zoom into, and any scale under 1 would expose ground. What 375 needs is ONE export of the board's own source at its ~0.9672 aspect to replace the flatten; after that a single per-width class (scale-[1.0586] with lg:scale-[1.1293], origin-top) closes BOTH boards from ONE asset. The CSS mechanism already exists and is shipped. NOT BUILT AND NOTHING EDITED: an export is new asset bytes, which is a design-pipeline act this lane does not take, and pulling Figma's own render into the repo is not the same as an asset from the art pipeline. CASEY CALL, and it is now a cheaper one than the row carried: (a) export c8ddb.png's source into modules/skai-gaming/src/assets/games/ and this lane closes both roulette boards with the existing mechanism, or (b) leave the flatten and both boards stay partial. ⚠ TWO BOARD FACTS RECORDED, NOT ACTED ON, both re-confirmed here: the Mobile grounds on solid #3051AA where crash, mines, plinko and slide ground on #001615; and its gradient START is 32.58% against the Desktop's 34.384% and the 41.8% PlayGameCard draws for every card, so roulette deviates from the system AND from itself across widths - the same shape crash shows, and per-game gradient stops remain a separate Casey item. No figure was invented, no asset was touched, no money path moved. Second witness file modules/skai-gaming/src/pages/play/playGameArtCovers.test.ts.
